messages:
jordan_csm: Quick heads up — our spend anomaly detector just flagged HelioWorks (hosted API) for overspend vs their monthly commit. Detector: 3.6M tokens used this week vs 1.2M committed. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/helioworks/usage :eyes:

maria_cs: ACK. Do we know if this is a single-day spike or sustained burn? Any latency/errors tied to the same window?

ops_bot: Alert: spend_threshold_exceeded | customer=helioworks | window=7d | detected_at=2026-03-16T18:02Z | peak_day=2026-03-16 | tokens=1_800_123 | reason=unusual-rate-increase

li_engineer: I'm pulling request logs now. There's a 10:42–11:15 UTC period with elevated retries (429s) from one API key. Could be a client-side retry loop inflating token counts. Will post sample logs in a sec.

aj_dev: Also rolled out micro-routing changes to prioritize rxl-13b for low-latency in us-east on Mar 15. If routing fallback failed for some sessions they might have been routed to rxl-70b for a short window — that could multiply token cost. Checking rollout canary logs.

jordan_csm: Noted. Customer is on a small monthly commit ($commit=1.2M tokens). If this is sustained they hit overage quickly. Can eng confirm root cause before I message them? I want to offer options: temporary cap, manual override, or billable overage with a one-time courtesy credit.

li_engineer: Quick sample query I ran to correlate source IPs & keys:

```
SELECT api_key, count(*) as requests, sum(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM request_logs
WHERE customer_id='helioworks' AND ts >= '2026-03-14'
GROUP BY api_key
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

li_engineer: Top API key accounts for ~72% of the extra tokens and shows a pattern of bursty calls every 15s. Looks like a client-side loop + no caching.

aj_dev: I'm seeing a routing mismatch for the same key — 11:02–11:10 some requests were routed to the larger variant because the smaller pool had transient OOMs. That explains higher per-request tokens due to longer generations. I can revert the micro-routing policy for that customer and put a hard cap on model size for their API key.

ryan_fin: We should prepare an invoice projection. If nothing changes this month projected overage = ~$1.7k. Jordan, we'll need approval to offer a partial credit.

maria_cs: Proposed immediate steps: 1) eng triage (li + aj) to fix routing / identify retry loop, 2) apply temporary token cap on the offending API key, 3) prep customer comms with options. Who owns each? :thumbsup:

jordan_csm: I'll own customer comms and offer the cap + 24h pause option while we investigate. Eng (li + aj) own triage; Ryan prepare invoice projection and credit options. Target: confirm root cause and actions by EOD today (1829123580).

li_engineer: Working on a short patch to ignore client retries with identical idempotency tokens and add a rate-limit rule for that API key. ETA 2h.

aj_dev: Reverting micro-routing for helioworks now and pinning model variant to rxl-13b for that key. Will monitor 30m.

ops_bot: Action created: CS-6543 (HelioWorks overspend triage) assigned to li_engineer, aj_dev, due=2026-03-16T23:59Z

jordan_csm: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the message to the customer and include the projected overage, the temporary cap option, and offer a one-time courtesy credit pending root cause. Will share draft here before sending. :white_check_mark:

ryan_fin: FYI finance approves up to 30% courtesy credit for first month in cases with platform routing issues.

maria_cs: Keep me posted, Jordan. If they accept the cap, schedule a follow-up onboarding touch to review best-practices (batching, idempotency, caching) to avoid recurrence.

jordan_csm: Draft sent in DM. Will paste final here once customer OKs. Closing thread when ops_bot updates CS-6543 to resolved. :lock:
